summary: A toggle for an on/off setting with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. Also applied by a disabled fieldset ancestor without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; holds the native input and positions the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The sliding circle; moves to the end of the track when on.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary; the thumb moves to the end (the start in right-to-left).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals through the FormAssociated mixin: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state, disabled (own or from a disabled fieldset) is not submitted, formStateRestore restores the saved state.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (24x16 for sm). The sm track is under 24px tall, so it relies on the label row and the 12px gap for the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception; the label is part of the clickable row.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Enter does not toggle: the APG leaves it optional for a switch.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; checked state exposed as aria-checked natively
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
on/off is never conveyed by color alone: the thumb position differs
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect as soon as it is flipped
The same on/off value is submitted with a form
The consequence of the setting needs explaining
The setting must be on before the form can be submitted
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is turned on

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only recorded when the form is submitted
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as an immediate setting; a recorded choice reads as a checkbox

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is a single on/off value

antiPatterns.pattern: Vague labels like "Option" or labels that flip meaning with the state
antiPatterns.why: The label is the only name for the switch; the state is announced separately
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that names the setting, stated the same way on and off

coverage: label is the name; label click toggles; role switch with aria-checked
Space toggles; Enter submits and does not toggle; keyboard focus ring
size default and sm dimensions; checked moves the thumb and paints differently
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle; change listener sees the new FormData
form value only while on, custom value, reset to attribute default, validity, disabled fieldset and re-enable, error customError, label for

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default track is input (neutral-200, dark input/80); changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract drafted from the visual reference, the WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern and the Checkbox contract as the form-control template. Proceed on that basis?
openQuestions.answer: Yes. Recommended and taken: no one was available to confirm.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, as Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked); checked is a property and the attribute is read at start.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which size values?
openQuestions.answer: default and sm, the shadcn names already registered as aliases of medium and small in spec/api.json. The existing size.switch.* tokens give 32x20 and 24x16.

openQuestions.question: What does Enter do?
openQuestions.answer: Submits the form (SB-0009), as every form control here. The APG makes Enter optional for a switch, so Space is the only toggle key.

openQuestions.question: Should the thumb be a custom element or native structure?
openQuestions.answer: A part inside the component's shadow root, over a native input with role=switch. No role is faked on a div.

openQuestions.question: Is a design-file (Figma) realization in scope?
openQuestions.answer: No. Platforms is web only until a design sync is requested; the Figma layer names already in spec/api.json are reused then.
